tokenName: Uganda National Oil Company Commodity-Backed Warehouse Token
underlyingAsset: Uganda state enterprise commodity receipt — mineral ore / agricultural produce stored at certified government warehousing facility
description: Uganda National Oil Company issues warehouse receipt tokens backed by commodities produced or procured by the enterprise. Token holders receive pro-rata claims on certified stored inventory, enabling smallholder suppliers to access immediate liquidity.
regulatoryFramework: Public Enterprises Reform and Divestiture Act; BOU Digital Finance Guidelines

tokenName: Uganda National Oil Company Workforce Service Contract Token
underlyingAsset: Uganda public sector service contract — vetted suppliers, maintenance contractors and consultants engaged by Uganda National Oil Company
description: Uganda National Oil Company tokenises service contracts with suppliers and independent contractors. Micro-enterprises and artisans can tokenise outstanding invoices as collateral for working-capital loans, eliminating the 90-day government payment delay.
regulatoryFramework: Public Enterprises Reform and Divestiture Act; BOU Digital Finance Guidelines

tokenName: Uganda National Oil Company Infrastructure PPP Token
underlyingAsset: Public-private partnership project in Uganda — managed by Uganda National Oil Company with mandatory 60% local employment quota
description: Uganda National Oil Company issues PPP tokens for capital infrastructure projects. Each token represents fractional participation in project revenue under a concession agreement. Smart contracts automatically enforce local hiring targets before milestone payments are released.
regulatoryFramework: Public Enterprises Reform and Divestiture Act; BOU Digital Finance Guidelines

tokenName: Uganda National Oil Company Public Real Estate Asset Token
underlyingAsset: Government-owned land and property portfolio managed by Uganda National Oil Company in Uganda
description: Uganda National Oil Company tokenises government property assets to unlock dormant balance-sheet value. Citizens can invest from 1 UGX unit and earn rental income proportional to token holdings, converting public assets into inclusive wealth-generation instruments.
regulatoryFramework: Public Enterprises Reform and Divestiture Act; BOU Digital Finance Guidelines

tokenName: Uganda National Oil Company Verified Labour Proof-of-Work Token
underlyingAsset: Daily economic activity of casual workers, contract staff and micro-vendors contracted by Uganda National Oil Company
description: Uganda National Oil Company issues proof-of-work tokens for every verified day of labour performed by casual workers on government contracts. Accumulated tokens build a portable credit score accepted by partner lenders, replacing the collateral requirement for the unbanked workforce.
regulatoryFramework: Public Enterprises Reform and Divestiture Act; BOU Digital Finance Guidelines

tokenName: Uganda National Oil Company Capital Project Milestone Token
underlyingAsset: Construction and development project milestones verified by independent engineers at Uganda National Oil Company projects in Uganda
description: Uganda National Oil Company issues milestone tokens that unlock progress payments only when independent inspectors verify project completion at each gate. This eliminates corruption in public procurement and ensures employment-creating contractors are paid promptly and fairly.
regulatoryFramework: Public Enterprises Reform and Divestiture Act; BOU Digital Finance Guidelines

tokenName: Uganda National Oil Company Agricultural Offtake Token
underlyingAsset: Smallholder and commercial farm produce procured by Uganda National Oil Company under government off-take programmes in Uganda
description: Uganda National Oil Company tokenises forward purchase agreements with smallholder farmers who supply the enterprise. Farmers receive pre-season financing in token form, redeemable at harvest. This removes predatory middlemen and connects subsistence farmers to institutional buyers.
regulatoryFramework: Public Enterprises Reform and Divestiture Act; BOU Digital Finance Guidelines

tokenName: Uganda National Oil Company SME Supply Chain Participation Token
underlyingAsset: Small and medium enterprise contracts awarded by Uganda National Oil Company under preferential procurement policies in Uganda
description: Uganda National Oil Company tokenises the economic value of SME contracts under its preferential procurement programme. Tokens can be listed on the national digital exchange, enabling impact investors to co-fund local businesses while earning competitive returns.
regulatoryFramework: Public Enterprises Reform and Divestiture Act; BOU Digital Finance Guidelines

tokenName: Uganda National Oil Company SOE Diversified Portfolio ETF Token
underlyingAsset: Diversified exposure to all tokenised assets across Uganda National Oil Company enterprise operations in Uganda
description: Uganda National Oil Company launches a basket ETF token spanning all 15 tokenised asset classes within its operations. A single token gives retail investors diversified exposure to infrastructure, commodities, labor, SME supply chains and government bonds from 1 UGX unit.
regulatoryFramework: Public Enterprises Reform and Divestiture Act; BOU Digital Finance Guidelines

tokenName: Uganda National Oil Company Partial State Equity Token
underlyingAsset: Fractional economic interest in Uganda National Oil Company — Uganda government retains majority ownership
description: Uganda National Oil Company issues fractional equity tokens representing an economic interest in enterprise profits. The government retains majority control while citizens, pension funds and diaspora investors access ownership stakes from 1 UGX unit, distributing national resource wealth broadly.
regulatoryFramework: Public Enterprises Reform and Divestiture Act; BOU Digital Finance Guidelines

tokenName: Uganda National Oil Company SOE Development Bond Token
underlyingAsset: Sovereign-backed development bond issued by Uganda National Oil Company to finance capital expansion in Uganda
description: Uganda National Oil Company tokenises government-guaranteed development bonds accessible from 1 UGX unit. Proceeds finance electrification, water, transport or ICT expansion projects. Quarterly coupon payments are streamed directly to token holders' wallets in real time.
regulatoryFramework: Public Enterprises Reform and Divestiture Act; BOU Digital Finance Guidelines

tokenName: Uganda National Oil Company Universal Access Financial Inclusion Token
underlyingAsset: Financial inclusion initiative of Uganda National Oil Company targeting unbanked and underserved communities in Uganda
description: Uganda National Oil Company deploys a universal access token to extend its core services to unbanked rural and peri-urban communities. Women's cooperatives, youth groups and disability enterprises receive preferential allocation at issuance, with minimal KYC via mobile digital identity.
regulatoryFramework: Public Enterprises Reform and Divestiture Act; BOU Digital Finance Guidelines

tokenName: Uganda National Oil Company Critical Mineral Royalty Token
underlyingAsset: Uganda critical mineral royalties and production-sharing revenue from Uganda National Oil Company operations
description: Uganda National Oil Company tokenises the mineral royalty stream from government-owned resource operations. Every citizen holding a royalty token receives a direct share of natural resource revenue, converting extractive industry profits into universal basic wealth distribution.
regulatoryFramework: Public Enterprises Reform and Divestiture Act; BOU Digital Finance Guidelines

tokenName: Uganda National Oil Company Farmer Verification Proof-of-Work Token
underlyingAsset: Satellite and IoT verified agricultural output records for farmers supplying Uganda National Oil Company in Uganda
description: Uganda National Oil Company mints an agriculture proof-of-work token for each independently verified farming event — planting, cultivation and harvest — recorded by satellite and IoT sensors. Verified records build a formal credit identity for smallholder farmers with no prior banking history.
regulatoryFramework: Public Enterprises Reform and Divestiture Act; BOU Digital Finance Guidelines

tokenName: Uganda National Oil Company End-to-End Supply Chain Track Token
underlyingAsset: Multi-step supply chain provenance trail from production through to delivery — managed by Uganda National Oil Company in Uganda
description: Uganda National Oil Company tokenises every custody transfer and logistics event across its supply chain on an immutable ledger. Each step earns employment tokens for transport operators and warehouse workers, creating a traceable, tamper-proof record from source to end consumer.
regulatoryFramework: Public Enterprises Reform and Divestiture Act; BOU Digital Finance Guidelines
